### Resin-bound grasp

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Grappled 2. **Standard defense:** Grappled 1.

**Limit:** The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

**Lifeless Body — Passive:** Does not breathe or eat; only its listed immunities apply.

**Heavy Frame — Passive:** Stability 1; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

**Healing:** Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** Its controller uses Fortitude defense when player-controlled; a player attacking it rolls only their attack.

**Senses:** Dark sight 6 squares; ordinary hearing.

**Tactics and retreat:** Hold an intruder near the tomb threshold, accepting the same Grappled burden. Release rather than let the whole party surround it.

**Encounter and conversation:** It guards promises recorded on the tomb walls; a broken promise can be repaired without stealing the burial goods.

**Habitat:** Crypt; burial ground; ruined settlement · **Communication:** Common; understands old oaths

**Loot:** Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

**Summoning:** Undead 7 — [player reference](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/summons/mummy.md).

**Ability sources:** [Clinging Recoil](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/clinging-recoil.md), [driving blow](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/driving-blow.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md), [rattle bones](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/rattle-bones.md), [seizing limbs](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/seizing-limbs.md).

# Clinging Recoil

*Something catches the striking limb: a clutching hand, a string of slime or a fold of adhesive flesh that drags at the next hurried step.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-clinging-recoil

**Action:** Reaction

After an adjacent attacker’s attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, apply Slowed 2 to that attacker. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. This grants no grapple, extra damage or equipment destruction.

monsterAbilityTemplates.name: Seizing Limbs
monsterAbilityTemplates.flavorMarkdown: *A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*
monsterAbilityTemplates.rulesMarkdown:
Use the printed attack. Standard also establishes Grappled 1; Strong establishes Grappled 2. A single holder’s contribution is replaced by its higher new result, not added to itself. Other holders stack normally. The holder suffers its own grapple contribution and cannot move while maintaining it. Release at any time without an action; death, unconsciousness or separation beyond the attack’s reach ends the hold. Force and external aid follow the core grapple rules.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
